items.title: Warren Buffett’s Favorite Type of Stock Is Perfect for Patient Investors
items.summary: Buffett once held hundreds of positions, yet only a tiny few have survived a decade. Coca-Cola, American Express and Moody's earned their spots, but one of them just missed earnings and another is sinking this year. Why does Berkshire still hold on?

items.title: JPMorgan, American Express and Travelers Are Raising Dividends for Retirees
items.summary: Three Dow financials pay yields under 2%, yet retirees keep piling in. Their secret is a payout that eats barely a quarter of earnings, and one of them has already survived a brutal cut that should give income seekers pause.

items.title: Dan Loeb and 8 Other Big Funds Bought Capital One Financial. Berkshire Hathaway and 14 Others Sold. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAmong the big funds that filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 9 bought Capital One Financial and 15 sold, and Berkshire Hathaway made the biggest sale. Capital One’s card losses fell in the third quarter, and Synchrony and American Express also reported lower loss rates than a year earlier.
